BOTTOM ROW four poses of brown-haired mustached merchant, white rolled-sleeve shirt, brown apron, brown pants and boots, seated in the SAME chair design as his reference. All eight face SCREEN LEFT, three-quarter view. Include whole chair and both feet fully inside each cell, no table. Maintain each person's head width and seated crown-to-sole height across four poses. Top row: 1 leaning slightly forward extending open near hand left at tabletop height to arrange a document (document not drawn); 2 same posture with near hand holding short feather quill at tabletop height ready to write (no paper drawn); 3 same writing posture with quill tip shifted slightly left and down, distinct subtle second writing frame; 4 holding a closed brown ledger against chest with far arm, near hand offering toward screen left. First three: a modest flat thin dry wooden lap-board rests horizontally ACROSS BOTH KNEES, not standing vertically in front of her. Maintain same glasses and facial scale and stool geometry, all hair, hands, sandal toes and stool legs fully visible with generous margins. No floor shadow, no table, no ground, no background, no text or labels, no other people. Clean pixel contours and restrained pixel shading matching references.
